Meta disputes columnist's claim that its Muse agent read private Mac messages

Inc. columnist Jason Aten says Muse quoted his messages with Full Disk Access switched off, and Meta says reading Messages needs three separate permissions.

https://theaipost.net/story/meta-muse-messages-dispute/

Dell, JERA and RHAELM plan a 400MW AI data centre beside a power plant

The $15 billion Chiba campus would draw power straight from JERA's own generators instead of the grid, with phased operation from 2028, according to JERA's announcement.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-jera-dell-rhaelm-chiba/

Hawley and Murphy plan a bill making AI firms liable when their agents hack
https://theaipost.net/story/hawley-murphy-ai-agent-accountability/

Anthropic makes Claude for Government generally available to US agencies

Anthropic says federal and state agencies can now buy Claude through a FedRAMP High environment with no seat fees, a hard spending cap and no cloud-provider contract.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-claude-for-government-ga/

GPT-6 Astra helps read a 217-year-old cipher letter to Napoleon's marshal
https://theaipost.net/story/find-marmont-cipher-gpt6-astra/

Research firm says AI agents probed a Canadian archive site, OpenAI reviewing
https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-agents-canada-library-archives/

South Korea's chip exports triple to $60.3 billion on AI demand

Semiconductors made up almost half of South Korea's record $120.9 billion in September exports, Reuters reported, as shipments rose 262.8% from a year earlier.

https://theaipost.net/story/korea-september-exports-record-chips/

Grokipedia v0.3 adds 3D book shelves and a redesigned homepage

SpaceXAI's Wikipedia rival, which Elon Musk says could one day become Encyclopedia Galactica, now shows featured articles as rotatable books and lists recent changes on its front page.

https://theaipost.net/story/grokipedia-v03/

260M-parameter image model tops one 6.5 times bigger, authors say
https://theaipost.net/story/cf964e66f/

Agent speed benchmark puts GPT-6 Astra first, open models nowhere
https://theaipost.net/story/c7afa8ac6/

Flow raises $50M at $750M to put AI agents on hardware design

The San Francisco startup says its agents check CAD drawings against requirements and test data. Anduril, Rivian and Joby Aviation are listed as customers, TechCrunch reported.

https://theaipost.net/story/flow-engineering-50m-series-b/

OpenAI says GPT-6.1 Sol is its most demanded model ever

OpenAI's Tibo Sottiaux says GPT-6.1 Sol drew record demand after DevDay, priced at $2 and $10 per million tokens against a $3.26 task cost for GPT-6 Astra.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-gpt-61-sol-devday/

Artificial Analysis puts Gemini 4 Argon level with GPT-6 Astra

The benchmark firm scores Google's unreleased Gemini 4 Argon 53 on its Intelligence Index, with a 15% hallucination rate against 51% for GPT-6 Astra.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-gemini-4-argon-aa-index/

AI chiefs sign a White House pledge that is only morally binding

Executives from Google, Anthropic, Meta, OpenAI, SpaceXAI and Nvidia signed a Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities that carries no legal force.

https://theaipost.net/story/trump-frontier-responsibilities-accord/

Senate blocks House-passed data-centre power bill 57-43 on party lines
https://theaipost.net/story/senate-blocks-ratepayer-protection-act/
